title: reader: missing should_panic test for from_credentials plaintext
description: The auth crate (crates/auth/src/store.rs) has a #[should_panic] test asserting from_credentials panics on a plaintext password. The reader's identical implementation (crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs) has no such test. A regression that removes or weakens the panic guard in the reader would pass CI undetected.
